label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The skip to main content link did not move me to the main content; focus landed on a promotion banner link, and the page has a long run of carousel controls and slide dots before any product
After activating a product tab in the featured products area, the new BUY link appeared earlier in the tab order than the tab button, so going forward I could not find it and had to go backwards
The Add to Cart button is only reached after about 40 tab stops: gallery images, colours, upsells, six Top Picks each with a Learn More link of the same name, and several links with no name
Many Learn More links share the identical name and only say they open in a new tab; I could not tell which product each belongs to. Three links in the delivery area had no name at all

After adding to cart I was moved to the cart page with no clear message. Tab order cycled endlessly between Close, Increase quantity of item and 0/1 Selected (gift selection), a focus trap; I never reached the Checkout button, and Escape only sent focus to the top of the page
